name: Chat-Drop Reference Clone Contract
purpose: Convert an uploaded/reference video into a durable production package that preserves measurable editing/animation grammar while rebuilding with Content Control characters and original scene content.

extraction_targets.timing: cut times, semantic beat boundaries, static holds, payoff timing
extraction_targets.motion: pose changes, anticipation, recoil, squash/stretch, object choreography
extraction_targets.camera: shot scale, zooms, pans, shakes, tracking, framing changes
extraction_targets.composition: subject placement, negative space, text zones, prop zones
extraction_targets.typography: placement, density, entry/exit rhythm, emphasis timing
extraction_targets.audio: dialogue cadence, silence, music energy, SFX timing and function
extraction_targets.retention: pattern interrupts, state changes, visual resets

hard_rules: preserve measured timing and motion function when useful
use locked Content Control characters, not reference creator characters
rewrite dialogue, jokes, staging, props, and distinctive creator identity
do not trace or recreate source frames shot-for-shot
rendered output must pass visual, audio, factual, caption, and live review QA
